heading: Applicability of this subchapter
lead: This subchapter applies only to the Reserve; except that it does not apply to a temporary member of the Reserve.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: Provisions similar to those in this section were contained in section 771 of this title prior to the complete revision of former chapter 21 of this title by Pub. L. 96–322.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 721 of this title as this section.
